_readme: Central asset map for the UFI site. Every image/video used in a page is looked up by key from here — never hardcode a Cloudinary URL in a component. Swapping a photo means editing one 'publicId' below, not touching code.

cdn.note: f_auto,q_auto lets Cloudinary auto-serve WebP/AVIF and compress per-browser. Always append this unless a specific override is needed.

video.note: Full cinematic case-study video. Loaded via a click-to-play facade — see hero demo. Never auto-embedded, so it never adds weight to first load.

home.hero.loop.note: Short, silent, seamless background loop only — never the full narrated case study.
